title: Contributing to ratatouille
text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("riparias/rato-occurrences", fork = TRUE). Install development dependencies devtools::install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing. Create Git branch pull request (PR). recommend using usethis::pr_init("brief-description--change"). Make changes, commit git, create PR running usethis::pr_push(), following prompts browser. title PR briefly describe change. body PR contain Fixes #issue-number. user-facing changes, add bullet top NEWS.md (.e. just first header). Follow style described https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html.

title: ratatouille 1.0.4
text: ratatouille() now always returns records specified source. (#53) Fixed bug token expire (refreshed) query took longer token expiry time. (#53) # ratatouille 1.0.3 Fixed bug RATO ArcGIS REST API returned error message part response object, ratatouille() fail cryptically parts query succeeded. (#50) # ratatouille 1.0.2 Fixed bug errors RATO ArcGIS REST API properly returned R errors, instead caused cryptic error without informative message. (#46) # ratatouille 1.0.1 magrittr longer direct dependency, package now uses base pipes |> internally. (#41) RATO REST API capacity can now set options() setting environmental variable RATO_API_CAPACITY. (#43) # ratatouille 1.0.0 Add ratatouille(), function fetch available invasive species data RATO single function call. (#36) functions now retry failed requests, fetching objects RATO ratatouille() throttle 1000 outstanding requests. (#36, #37) Add package wide options ratatouille.rato_expires_minutes, default 5 minutes ratatouille.cache_max_age_secs, default 150 seconds. allow easy modification cache behaviour. (#36)
